breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the actual varying area function A(x) = A0·(1 + k·x/L) directly in the integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx, without replacing it with an arithmetic mean area. The flawed instruction to substitute the arithmetic mean area and treat it as exact has been removed, aligning with the ground truth prompt.
